summary: STR-001: wired login/logout + Authorization headers through the Lifeboat UI. public/app.js now stores the /api/auth/login session token in localStorage, getJSON/postJSON/patchJSON attach 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' when set, logout POSTs /api/auth/logout (server-side revocation, SEC-002) then clears local state, and every page's nav gained a login form / account-chip + logout widget (renderAuth, with GET /api/auth/me validation of the stored token).
root_cause: The shared UI helpers (getJSON/postJSON/patchJSON in public/app.js) never sent authentication and no page had any login/logout UI, so every authed endpoint (film import, claim approval, buyer import, library) was unusable from the UI.
fix: apps/lifeboat/public/app.js: token/account localStorage storage (dfl.token, dfl.account) with try/catch for private-mode safety
apps/lifeboat/public/app.js: DFL.login(email,password) -> POST /api/auth/login, stores token+account; DFL.logout() -> POST /api/auth/logout with Bearer, best-effort, then clears local state
apps/lifeboat/public/app.js: authHeaders() attaches 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' in getJSON/postJSON/patchJSON when a token is set; no header when absent

apps/lifeboat/public/app.js: renderAuth() widget (login form when signed out, account chip + logout when signed in, /api/auth/me validation with 401 -> drop stale token), hosted in renderNav so every page gets it
apps/lifeboat/public/styles.css: .dfl-auth styles matching the dark theme
devteam/repro/str-001-ui-auth.js: 15-check node regression (loads app.js with shimmed window/localStorage/fetch); wired into test.sh STR-001 section

evidence.repro: devteam/repro/str-001-ui-auth.js: 15/15 checks pass on fixed code; FAILS on pre-fix code (DFL.login is not a function) — genuinely falsifiable
evidence.suite: full lifeboat suite on fresh port 18107 (never :8080): PASS=136 FAIL=0 (135 baseline + 1 new STR-001), exit 0

challenge_results: All authed UI calls flow through the three shared helpers, so the Bearer injection covers every page at once; no per-page changes needed.
logout clears local state even if the network request fails (fail-closed locally); server-side revocation is best-effort.
Stored token validated against GET /api/auth/me on nav render; a stale/expired token is dropped silently rather than showing a false signed-in state.
XSS: account email rendered through the existing esc() helper.
